model.name: The units sbmlsim gives the entities, the rules of libsbml

body.p: The rules by which libsbml derives the unit of a kinetic law and sbmlsim names units (UnitsInformation.from_sbml_doc): a kinetic law per rule, parameters of unit definitions of every form sbmlsim writes. The model units of scripts/scan_fixtures.py pin them for sbmlsim-core; the model is no model of biology and its units are inconsistent on purpose.
